verdict.rationale: The Delaware Division of Corporations is a state business-entity registry and tax-filing office, not a platform that hosts user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows any automation feature that would make the axis apply: the filing channels are fillable PDFs, upload, fax or mail, and the portal's saved session ID is not an automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
